## Checklist

- [ ] Tests written first and passing; coverage stays at 80% or above
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes locally
- [ ] `pnpm test:security` passes (required if auth, sanitising, limits, secrets or routes changed)
- [ ] README updated if users see a change
- [ ] No secrets, keys or private data in the diff
- [ ] Inputs validated at the boundary; no new unsanitised model output rendered
- [ ] No attribution footers in commits or this description
